Not yet. Please hold off on telling the harbour office.

The 41 passing tests came from `uv run pytest -q`, which is not the project's test command. CONTRIBUTING.md says to run `just test`, which adds `--recorded-feeds`. Without that flag, the tests in `tests/feeds/` aren't collected, and those replay recorded timetable feeds. They are the ones most likely to exercise departures across the autumn clock change. So my run shows the rest of the suite still passes, but it says nothing about whether the bug is fixed.

I would do this, in order:

No file changes before the check. The edit to `ferry/feeds/departures.py` stays as it is until the results come back.

1. Run the project's full test command:

<command>just test</command>

2. Read the whole output and check the exit code and the failure count. I'd also confirm the feed tests were collected, since the total should be higher than 41.

3. Check the original symptom directly. If no recorded feed covers a departure just after the autumn change, I'd propose adding one as a regression test. I'd check that it fails with my change reverted and passes with it restored. I'd ask you before adding it, since that means new test files.

Once I've run `just test`, I'll send you the actual output. If everything passes, including the feed tests, you can tell the harbour office. If anything fails, I'll tell you what and keep working on the fix.
